name: tutor_profile
description: Private tutor application and tutor-editable draft fields; no administrator decision fields

user_id.description: Buildy user id of the tutor who owns this application

photo_base64.description: Private resized JPEG or PNG profile image data, never a public URL

photo_mime_type.description: MIME type of the private resized photo

time_zone.description: Tutor's IANA time zone for weekly availability

hourly_rate_cents.description: Tutor hourly rate stored in USD cents; zero means not yet set in a draft

intro_video_url.description: Optional unlisted YouTube or Vimeo link, never a video upload

intro_video_unlisted_confirmed.description: Tutor confirms the intro video is unlisted

meeting_link.description: Tutor's Zoom or Google Meet link, private to the application

agreement_accepted.description: Whether the tutor accepted the displayed commission, cancellation, and conduct agreement

application_intent.description: Tutor-editable draft or submission intent, not an administrator decision

submission_revision.description: Revision number submitted by the tutor

draft_step.description: Last application step saved for resume
